title: simulation-triage result.json contract
description: Complete contract for <module>/Verification/simulation-triage/result.json. One entry per finding: `root_cause` names the rule that must act on THAT finding (the reap mints one diagnosis per distinct value, so one analysis routes to as many owners as it found causes), `anchor` is its fix locus, and `reason` is the argument the fix owner acts on — the fix owner is handed this file and nothing else, so a finding whose reason is absent arrives as a coordinate with no account, and the owner fixes whatever is at that line. An empty findings[] is the only way to say the analysis reached no attribution, and then the top-level `reason` says why. Whatever an experiment produced rides in the envelope's own artifacts[], like every other stage's products.

reason.description: Why this cause and this locus: the evidence you read and the inference from it, in enough detail that the fix owner can check your reading against the artifact rather than take it on trust.

cases.description: Which of the failing run's cases this finding explains, by the test_id the failing envelope's failing_cases[] used.

reason.description: Required when findings[] is empty: why this analysis reached no attribution.
